lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense array of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the five gill slits, arranged in approximately four to five discernible horizontal rows that follow the body's longitudinal curvature.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, particularly in the mid-flank region, intersecting with the horizontal spot rows to create a non-uniform grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient transition from light-reflective pixels on the dorsal side to a shadow-cast region immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, elongated teleost (remora) is visible in the ventral-lateral region near the base of the pectoral fin, characterized by a dark body with a high-luminance longitudinal stripe.
